ref: #2 §1 nested queues: "The number of contexts of a queue must be the same as the number of values (empty strings) of the upper-level queue", and a structure field's queue holds one empty string per occurrence [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_em900/helpdata/en/4b/fbd21666d33de4e10000000a42189e/content.htm]; #2 §2: "Structure fields with n = minOccurs = maxOccurs > 0 are generated automatically, n times, whatever the mapping" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_em900/helpdata/en/4b/f414f7eaca4c86e10000000a42189e/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bf414f7eaca4c86e10000000a42189e.html]
note: Item from the source structure field Order in context Orders: one empty string per Order, "", "", "", so three Items with slot numbers 1, 2, 3, although Order 2 has no Id. Tag per Tag in context Order: x, y | z | w; Item k reads context k. Sku per Sku in context Order: a, b | (empty) | c, under the unmapped 1..1 Info, whose slot number is its Item's. Each Item also gets its two empty Twins. Reading Order as a leaf would give its text, and mapping from Id would give two Items.
